description: Roll a recipe back to an earlier revision (ingredients, steps, filing, all fields). Overwrites the current fields with the old revision's; the current version is kept as a revision, so it can be undone with another restore_revision. Get revision_no from list_history first. Needs edit access; blocked on read-only accounts. Returns the restored recipe.

id.description: Recipe id (UUID) from search_recipes or an earlier result

name: restore_revision
title: Undo a recipe change
